quarterly_data.quarter: AT&S press release: AT&S and Marvell Technology expand collaboration to support (09-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Kulim (Malaysia) expansion: AT&S states that the previously announced expansion of its Kulim site includes the fit-out of Plant 2 and the construction of a new manufacturing facility for IC substrate cores and advanced packaging, supported by long-term customer commitments/agreements, and identifies Marvell Technology as the additional customer in that expansion. CFO Gerrit Steen said the agreements supporting the expansion let AT&S invest alongside its customers while maintaining financial flexibility and a strong balance sheet. No capacity, capex or timing figures stated.

contracts.source: AT&S press release: AT&S and Marvell Technology expand collaboration to support (09-22-2026)
contracts.signal: AT&S announced an expanded collaboration with Marvell Technology under a long-term agreement to increase advanced IC substrate capacity for next-generation AI and cloud infrastructure; the agreement builds on the companies' existing relationship and supports Marvell's growing demand for advanced substrates. Marvell is the additional customer identified in AT&S's previously announced Kulim site expansion (Plant 2 fit-out plus a new facility for IC substrate cores and advanced packaging). Marvell SVP and Chief Supply Chain Officer Vinay Krishna said the expanded collaboration strengthens Marvell's supply chain foundation. No volumes, dollar value or signing date stated.
